name: Badolatosa (Spain)
description: Divided into three diagonal bands from the upper fly to the lower hoist, white at the upper hoist, yellow in the centre and blue at the lower fly.
history: Municipal flag of Badolatosa; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: white area at the upper hoist
blue area at the lower fly
